reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is the curse of dimensionality in stochastic dynamic programming. By leveraging network flow structure, we decouple the state vector into modular components. This yields a dual decomposition where the inner flow subproblems can be solved independently, drastically reducing computational complexity. However, the approximation error arises because we ignore cross-reservoir interactions in the value function, leading to suboptimal global decisions when inflows are highly correlated.
